authentication.loginPasswordOnly: The admin API uses an authenticated administrator account; sensitive account deletion requires the account login password, never the master password.

overview.title: Console overview
overview.description: Server health and aggregate activity. No user vault contents are available here.
overview.cleanupDescription: Last cleanup time and result; the retention period is fixed at 30 days.

settings.title: Server settings
settings.description: Only the documented allowlist is configurable. Values are loaded from the server; the source shows where each value is set.
settings.nullClearNote: When enabled, clearing a managed value sends explicit null; an empty string is never used to clear a setting.
settings.tombstoneRetentionDescription: Fixed retention period; it is not part of the editable settings allowlist.
settings.smtpPasswordStatusDescription: Only whether a password is configured may be shown; its value is never returned or echoed.

constraints.serverName: Text · 1–100 characters; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

dump.title: Encrypted database dump
dump.description: Downloads an encrypted database dump. It does not export any user's vault.
dump.loginPasswordNote: The login password is sent only to verify this download and is never stored. The master password is not accepted here.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Admin actions are shown as metadata only; login history is a separate log.
audit.metadataPolicy: Only keys_changed or device_id are allowed; other actions show an empty object.
audit.sensitiveDataWarning: Vault entries, item names, URLs, password lengths, secrets, tokens, and hashes must never appear in this log.
audit.noRows: No audit rows match these filters.

users.title: User management
users.description: Search accounts, inspect devices and login history, and manage access. Vault entries and contents are never shown.
users.listMeta: Filters combine with AND · Newest accounts first · Cursor paging (100 default, 500 max)
users.deleteRequirement: Deletion is irreversible: confirm twice and re-enter the administrator login password. Never use the master password.
users.roleGuardrail: Super-admin cannot be assigned or transferred. Restricted self-actions and super-admin protections still apply.
users.vaultGuardrail: Vault entries, item names, URLs, password lengths and secret values are never shown; user vaults cannot be exported.
users.selectUserHint: Select a user from the list to inspect profile details.
users.devicesEmpty: No devices registered for this account.
users.devicesDescription: All devices are ordered by registration time.
users.loginHistoryEmpty: No login records for this account.
users.loginHistoryDescription: Separate login log, newest first with its own cursor.
users.actionForbidden: This administrator action is not permitted.
users.confirmDelete: Delete this account permanently? This cannot be undone.
users.confirmRevokeAll: Revoke all devices for this account? The account stays enabled; the user must sign in again.
